description: Who opened a document or page you own, edit, or published: views, signed-in readers, and which Version each last opened. On a company document or page it names every member who can open it, with their opens and, for a document, whether they read the latest version; company admins read it for every company item. Use it to answer 'who has read the policy?' or 'has the team opened the dashboard?'. A reader list carries email addresses, so answer the question asked rather than pasting it.
